web_context.competitor_activity: BYD overtook Tesla as the world's largest battery EV producer in 2025 but its Q1 2026 net income fell 55% YoY and revenue dropped 12%; 100%+ U.S. tariffs keep BYD out of North America. Rivian gained momentum with a $1B Volkswagen equity investment and $4.5B DOE loan, posting Q1 revenue of $1.38B (+11% YoY) and deliveries of 10,365 units (+20% YoY). Lucid fell 33% in April after an EPS miss and -$1.24B free cash flow; it is eyeing a 2027 midsize affordable EV. Legacy OEM competition (GM, Ford) remains muted in EV segment. Overall, near-term U.S. EV competition is manageable for Tesla given tariff protections; the real long-run threat is Rivian at the truck/SUV segment and Chinese OEMs if tariffs ever ease.
